pictures.name: CMG1-Star-East
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. A vast desert at night in ancient Persia, dunes and a distant city of domed towers. In the middle, three magi from the east: an elderly scholar with a long white beard in deep blue robes and a tall cap, a middle-aged man with a black beard in crimson silk and a turban, and a young man with dark skin in gold and green robes, stand on a rooftop observatory with brass instruments and scrolls, pointing up in wonder at one new brilliant star rising above the horizon; below, servants load camels with chests. Deep blue starry night, one bright gold star. Wonder, discovery, longing. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: CMG2-Herod-Palace
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. A lavish marble throne hall in Herod’s palace in Jerusalem, lamplit at night, gold and purple hangings. King Herod, a heavy older man with a short grey beard in a jeweled robe and a gold crown, leans forward on his throne, smiling falsely but eyes suspicious. Before him, three magi from the east: an elderly scholar with a long white beard in deep blue robes and a tall cap, a middle-aged man with a black beard in crimson silk and a turban, and a young man with dark skin in gold and green robes, stand in their travel-dusty fine robes, asking. Courtiers whisper in the shadows. Warm gold lamplight, deep blue shadows. Unease, danger beneath splendor. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: CMG3-Gifts-House
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. Inside a simple stone house in Bethlehem at night, lit by lamps and by starlight falling through the window from one bright star above. Mary, a young woman with dark hair under a soft blue veil, sits on a low bench holding a small child of about one year sitting on his mother’s lap, turned toward her, his face hidden and never visible; Joseph, a man of about thirty with a short dark beard, in a brown tunic and travel cloak, stands behind them. Before them, three magi from the east: an elderly scholar with a long white beard in deep blue robes and a tall cap, a middle-aged man with a black beard in crimson silk and a turban, and a young man with dark skin in gold and green robes, kneel on a woven rug, offering an open gold casket, a carved box of frankincense with a curl of smoke, and an alabaster jar of myrrh. Warm gold light, deep blue night. Adoration, wonder, humility. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: CMG4-Dream-Warning
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. A desert camp outside Bethlehem before dawn. The three magi sleep in a striped tent; the elderly one in deep blue robes sits up suddenly, wide awake, as a soft pale gold light of an angel fades at the tent opening. Beyond, the camels stand ready on a different road winding away east, away from Jerusalem’s distant walls. Deep blue pre-dawn light, gold glow. Warning, a change of path. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: CMG5-Flight-Night
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. A moonlit desert road heading toward Egypt at night. In the middle, Mary, a young woman with dark hair under a soft blue veil, rides a small grey donkey, holding a small child bundled against her shoulder, his face hidden in her veil, while Joseph, a man of about thirty with a short dark beard, in a brown tunic and travel cloak, leads the donkey on foot, a bundle on his back, looking back watchfully. Palm trees and dunes, a vast starry sky. Deep blue night, silver moonlight with a touch of warm gold from a small lantern. Refugees, courage, protection. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: CMG6-Today-Chalk-Door
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. A modern family home on a snowy January afternoon, painted in the same sacred oil style: a father lifts his young daughter so she can chalk a few simple marks above the front door frame, crosses and a star, while a mother holds a bowl of chalk and a little boy in a paper crown laughs. The chalk marks are simple shapes, no readable letters. Warm gold light from inside the house, deep blue winter twilight. The doorway in the middle. Blessing, welcome, joy. No text, no letters, no logos.
